description: Four-panel provenance figure mapping the CG33090-PC truncation onto GH116 architecture, catalytic distances, AlphaFold confidence and newly exposed surface
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
import pandas as pd

ss=json.load(open("out/ss.json")); strands=[tuple(s) for s in ss["strands"]]; helices=[tuple(h) for h in ss["helices"]]
mind={int(k):v for k,v in json.load(open("out/mind.json"))["mind"].items()}
afc=json.load(open("out/af_compare.json"))
sas=json.load(open("out/sasa.json"))
LOST=117

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(4,1, height_ratios=[1.1,1.5,1.4,1.4], hspace=0.55)

# ---- panel A: GH116 architecture on TxGH116 (5BVU) ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); ax.set_xlim(0,805); ax.set_ylim(0,1)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((31,0.42),410-31,0.16,color="#9fb3c8"))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((416,0.42),801-416,0.16,color="#d9b38c"))
for a,b in strands: ax.add_patch(Rectangle((a,0.62),max(b-a,1),0.14,color="#2b5f8e"))
for a,b in helices: ax.add_patch(Rectangle((a,0.62),max(b-a,1),0.14,color="#b35c2e"))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((31,0.30),LOST-31,0.52,fill=False,ec="#c0392b",lw=2.2,ls="--"))
ax.text((31+LOST)/2,0.88,"absent from CG33090-PC\n(TxGH116 31-117)",ha="center",va="bottom",color="#c0392b",fontsize=9)
for r,lab in [(441,"E441\nnucleophile"),(593,"D593\nacid/base")]:
    ax.plot([r],[0.36],marker="v",color="k",ms=9); ax.text(r,0.04,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.text(220,0.50,"N-terminal $\\beta$-sandwich",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.text(610,0.50,"C-terminal ($\\alpha/\\alpha$)$_6$ catalytic domain",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("TxGH116 residue (5BVU author numbering)")
ax.set_title("A. GH116 architecture (TxGH116, PDB 5BVU) with the CG33090-PC truncation mapped on",loc="left",fontsize=11)

# ---- panel B: distance to catalytic pair ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
xs=sorted(mind); ys=[mind[x] for x in xs]
ax.axvspan(31,LOST,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.14)
ax.plot(xs,ys,lw=0.8,color="#34495e")
ax.axhline(4.5,color="#27ae60",ls=":",lw=1); ax.text(805,4.8,"4.5 A: first shell",ha="right",fontsize=8,color="#27ae60")
lo=[x for x in xs if x<=LOST]; best=min(lo,key=lambda x: mind[x])
ax.plot([best],[mind[best]],"o",color="#c0392b")
ax.annotate(f"closest lost residue Y62\n{mind[best]:.1f} A",(best,mind[best]),xytext=(150,14),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"),color="#c0392b",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("TxGH116 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("min heavy-atom distance\nto E441/D593 (A)")
ax.set_title("B. The PC-lost segment contributes no residue within 8 A of the catalytic pair",loc="left",fontsize=11)

# ---- panel C: pLDDT ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
x=np.arange(29,800)
ax.plot(x,afc["pl_Q"],lw=0.7,color="#7f8c8d",label="in full-length CG33090-PB (res 178-948)")
ax.plot(x,afc["pl_P"],lw=0.7,color="#2980b9",label="in CG33090-PC (res 29-799)")
ax.axhline(70,color="k",ls=":",lw=0.8); ax.axhline(90,color="k",ls=":",lw=0.8)
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlabel("CG33090-PC residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title(f"C. AlphaFold confidence of the shared chain is barely changed by the truncation "
             f"(mean {np.mean(afc['pl_P']):.1f} vs {np.mean(afc['pl_Q']):.1f}; core C-alpha RMSD {afc['rms_core']:.2f} A)",
             loc="left",fontsize=11)

# ---- panel D: newly exposed surface ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[3])
d=pd.DataFrame(sas["delta"],columns=["res","aa","dSASA","rel_PC","rel_full"])
HYD=set("AVLIMFWYC")
col=["#c0392b" if a in HYD else "#95a5a6" for a in d.aa]
ax.bar(d.res,d.dSASA,color=col,width=1.0)
ax.set_xlabel("CG33090-PC residue"); ax.set_ylabel("$\\Delta$SASA, PC minus full length ($\\AA^2$)")
ax.set_title(f"D. Truncation uncovers {sas['tot_new']:.0f} $\\AA^2$ of surface on the retained chain, "
             f"{sas['newhyd']:.0f} $\\AA^2$ of it hydrophobic (red)",loc="left",fontsize=11)
plt.show()
